items.en: Perfect grips make later grips stronger and wider, but harder to time. A mistimed release resets the bonuses. Can overfill your bag to 150%; start below full.
items.text: 完美抓握會強化後續抓握的威力與範圍，但時機把控更為嚴苛。鬆開時機失誤將重設所有加成。允許超載至背包容量的 150%；觸發時背包須未滿載。

items.en: Master grip can reach six bonus levels. Its sweet spot arrives sooner, but becomes slightly shorter. A mistimed release still resets the bonuses.
items.text: 抓握大師至多可疊加六層加成。最佳時機判定提前到來，但判定視窗略微收窄。鬆開時機失誤仍會重設所有加成。

items.en: Hold {0} to collect with a ghost hand. Stronger and faster tools improve its grabs. It can trigger your learned Heavy Strike and lightning effects.
items.text: 按住 {0} 收集時，幽靈之手也會抓取金幣。工具越強、越快，其抓取效果越好。可觸發已習得的重擊和閃電效果。

items.en: Three ghost hands take turns gathering gold while you hold {0} to collect.
items.text: 按住 {0} 收集時，三隻幽靈之手將交替協助蒐集黃金。

items.en: Five ghost hands search nearby gold, even when you are not aiming directly at it. Keep holding {0} to collect.
items.text: 五隻幽靈之手會尋找附近金幣，無需直接瞄準。持續按住 {0} 即可收集。

items.en: At full Flow, a sixth ghost hand joins in and the crew grabs faster. Keep holding {0} to collect.
items.text: 心流滿格時，第六隻幽靈之手將加入協助，且全隊抓取頻率加快。持續按住 {0} 即可進行收集。

items.en: With Hands, hold {0} and release in the sweet spot for a large haul. Stronger grabs and a bigger bag increase the coin limit. Needs nearby gold and bag space.
items.text: 使用雙手時，按住 {0} 並在最佳時機鬆開，可一次收集大量金幣。更強的抓取能力和更大的背包可提高收集上限。需要附近有金幣且背包未滿。

items.en: Equip Shovel with {0} to scoop gold. Learned Heavy Strikes are stronger and trigger more often with this tool.
items.text: 按 {0} 裝備鏟子來鏟取黃金。使用此工具時，已習得的重擊威力更強，觸發更頻繁。

items.en: Your pickups can trigger a strike that collects extra nearby gold. It triggers more often and collects more coins with the Shovel.
items.text: 拾取時有機率觸發重擊，額外收集附近黃金。使用鏟子時觸發更頻繁，收集的金幣也更多。

items.en: Heavy Strikes collect more gold across a larger area, with a higher minimum coin limit.
items.text: 重擊在更大範圍內收集更多黃金，最低金幣收集上限也更高。

items.en: Heavy Strikes collect more gold and reach at least 4 m around the impact. They also trigger more reliably and recharge faster.
items.text: 重擊收集更多黃金，衝擊周圍的覆蓋半徑至少為 4 米。重擊觸發更穩定，冷卻也更快。

items.en: With Shovel, hold {0} for 0.65s, then release a stronger, wider scoop. Limited by nearby gold and bag space.
items.text: 使用鏟子時，按住 {0} 0.65 秒後鬆開，進行更強、更寬的鏟取。受附近黃金量和背包剩餘空間限制。

items.en: With Shovel, hold {0} for 0.65s to leap toward your aim and slam on landing. Bigger falls strengthen the impact. Replaces Power scoop. Maximum radius: 15 m, including falls.
items.text: 使用鏟子時，按住 {0} 0.65 秒，向瞄準方向躍起，並在落地時重砸。下落距離越大，衝擊越強。替代強力鏟取。包括下落加成在內，最大半徑為 15 米。

items.en: Jackhammer collects more gold, digs deeper and recharges faster. Limited by reachable gold and bag space.
items.text: 衝擊錘收集更多黃金、挖掘更深，冷卻也更快。受可觸及的黃金量和背包剩餘空間限制。

items.en: Increase Jackhammer's collection radius. Heavy Strike builds benefit too. The total radius cannot exceed 15 m, including falls.
items.text: 提高衝擊錘的收集半徑。重擊配置也能受益。包括下落加成在內，總半徑不能超過 15 米。

items.en: Jackhammer can collect twice as many coins and digs deeper. Limited by reachable gold and bag space.
items.text: 衝擊錘最多可收集雙倍金幣，挖掘也更深。受可觸及的黃金量和背包剩餘空間限制。

items.en: Jackhammer can collect 50% more coins, digs deeper and recharges faster. Limited by reachable gold and bag space.
items.text: 衝擊錘最多可多收集 50% 的金幣，挖掘更深，冷卻更快。受可觸及的黃金量和背包剩餘空間限制。

items.en: Your pickups can release lightning that jumps between coin patches, collecting extra gold. It collects more gold with the Magnet.
items.text: 拾取時有機率釋放閃電，在金幣區域之間彈跳，額外收集黃金。使用磁鐵時收集的黃金更多。

items.en: Lightning splits into three chains and collects more gold over a wider area. The chains share each bounce's coin limit.
items.text: 閃電分為三條鏈，在更大範圍內收集更多黃金。各條鏈共享每次彈跳的金幣上限。

items.en: Lightning spreads through six chains, with more bounces and faster recharge. It triggers more reliably. The chains share each bounce's coin limit.
items.text: 閃電擴散為六條鏈，彈跳次數增加，冷卻更快。觸發也更穩定。各條鏈共享每次彈跳的金幣上限。

items.en: With Magnet, press {0} to launch lightning through nearby gold. Stronger pickups and lightning upgrades improve the haul. The chains share each bounce's coin limit.
items.text: 使用磁鐵時，按 {0} 向附近黃金釋放閃電。更強的拾取能力和閃電升級可提高收集量。各條鏈共享每次彈跳的金幣上限。

items.en: Magnetic Pulse collects more gold and hits a wider area. Its chains share each bounce's coin limit.
items.text: 磁脈衝收集更多黃金，命中範圍也更廣。各條鏈共享每次彈跳的金幣上限。

items.en: Increase how much Magnetic Pulse can collect at each bounce. Its chains share the coin limit.
items.text: 提高磁脈衝每次彈跳可收集的金幣量。各條鏈共享金幣上限。

items.en: Magnetic Pulse collects more gold at each bounce and recharges faster. Its chains share the coin limit.
items.text: 磁脈衝每次彈跳收集更多黃金，冷卻也更快。各條鏈共享金幣上限。

items.text: 輸送槽永久排幣速率 +12.5%。按 [{0}] 使排幣速率變為三倍，持續 8 秒。冷卻時間：45 秒。

items.en: Pocket Bank collects from farther away. Hold {0} within 3 m to unload at half normal speed.
items.text: 隨身銀行可從更遠處收集。在 3 米內按住 {0}，以正常速度的一半卸幣。

items.en: Manually empty a bag with at least 25% capacity, capped at 10,000 coins, to boost Pocket Bank collection by 50% for 8 seconds.
items.text: 手動將背包存空，可使隨身銀行收集速率提高 50%，持續 8 秒。最低存入量取背包容量的 25% 與 10,000 枚金幣中的較小值。

items.en: Unload into Pocket Bank at 75% of normal station speed.
items.text: 向隨身銀行卸幣的速度為普通存幣站的 75%。

items.en: Pocket Bank's automatic collection rate +100%, including its maximum rate. Limited by visible gold within range.
items.text: 隨身銀行自動收集速率 +100%，包括最高速率。受範圍內可見黃金量限制。

items.en: Pocket Bank's automatic collection rate +100%, including its maximum rate. Bank radius: 9 → 12 m. Bag capacity +33.11%.
items.text: 隨身銀行自動收集速率 +100%，包括最高速率。銀行半徑：9 → 12 米。背包容量 +33.11%。

items.en: Click for a snappy 12-coin pull. Hold to keep snapping gold into your hand. No charging.

items.text: 按住滑鼠左鍵並走動即可耙金。移動過程中每次耙動至多撈取 16 枚金幣；原地靜止時停止收集。

items.en: Jump 65% higher. Passive; no fuel, no slot, no prerequisites.
items.text: 跳躍高度提高 65%。被動效果；無需燃料、不佔欄位、無前置條件。

items.text: 走過金幣時每 0.5 秒自動聚攏周圍至多 6 枚金幣。背包滿載時暫停。

items.en: Move 25% faster. Shorten bank trips or race along the galleries. Always active.
items.text: 移動速度提升 25%。大幅縮短往返存幣時間或穿梭於坑道之間。常駐生效。

items.en: Click or hold to punch a crisp 90-coin line through gold every 0.45 seconds. A 12m beam; walls stop it.
items.text: 點選或按住，每 0.45 秒發射一道直線光束，最多收集 90 枚金幣。射程 12 米，會被牆壁阻擋。

items.en: Hold to bore straight down: 100 coins per pulse while you move freely. Watch the heat gauge and release to cool. Pushing past 2 seconds of heat overheats the drill for 3 seconds.
items.text: 按住向下鑽取，每次脈衝收集 100 枚金幣，期間可自由移動。注意熱量表，鬆開可降溫；積累 2 秒熱量後會過熱，停機冷卻 3 秒。

items.en: Click to start suction. Hold LMB to raise pressure, release to lower it. Track the moving green zone; strain recovers slowly. Losing control spills your bag and triggers an 8-second repair.
items.text: 點選啟動吸取。按住滑鼠左鍵增壓，鬆開降壓。保持在動態移動的綠色區間內；過載負荷恢復緩慢。操作失控將導致背包金幣散落，並觸發持續 8 秒的停機維修。

items.en: +11,000 carry. 15,000 total with earlier bags, before skill bonuses.
items.text: 背包容量 +11,000。結合先前背包後基礎容量達 15,000（技能加成前）。

items.en: 30x base deposit speed. Replaces the liner's 8x bonus.
items.text: 基礎存幣速度提升至 30 倍（替換內襯的 8 倍加成）。

items.en: Press jump again in mid-air for one extra jump. Recharges on landing. Works without spring boots.
items.text: 空中再次按下跳躍鍵可實現二段跳。著陸後重設充能。無需裝備彈簧靴即可生效。

items.en: G throws it with any tool equipped. Stores up to 1,200 coins. Walk over to collect, or right-click to recall through a clear path.
items.text: 裝備任意工具時均可按 G 投擲，最多儲存 1,200 枚金幣。走近可回收，或在路徑無阻擋時按滑鼠右鍵召回。

items.en: Click or hold for a chunky 280-coin spread every 0.6 seconds. A quick pump and a recoil hop keep you moving.
items.text: 點選或按住，每 0.6 秒進行一次扇形收集，最多收集 280 枚金幣。快速泵動和後坐力小跳讓你保持移動。

items.en: Hold LMB to preview; release on green to place. Collects visible gold within 12 m; Local branch extends this to 16 m. Banks 30 coins/sec plus 3 per 1,000 bag capacity, up to 150/sec. Hold F nearby to relocate.
items.text: 按住滑鼠左鍵預覽，預覽變綠時鬆開放置。自動收集 12 米內可見的金幣；在地分行將範圍擴大至 16 米。每秒存入 30 枚金幣，背包容量每增加 1,000，再增加 3 枚，上限為每秒 150 枚。靠近後按住 F 收起。

items.en: +25,000 carry. 40,000 total with earlier bags, before skill bonuses.
items.text: 背包容量 +25,000。結合先前背包後基礎容量達 40,000（技能加成前）。

items.en: 90x base deposit speed. Pour large hauls into any hopper.
items.text: 基礎存幣速度為 90 倍，可在任意存幣料斗快速卸幣。

items.en: Hold jump while falling to float gently down. Steer across gaps; release to drop normally.
items.text: 下落時按住跳躍鍵可緩慢飄落。調整方向可越過空隙；鬆開則恢復正常下落。

items.en: Hold to crack lightning into gold. Each strike automatically chains across up to four nearby patches, 180 coins each. No marking or charging.
items.text: 按住即可引導電弧轟擊金堆。每道電光會自動連鎖傳導至多 4 處相鄰金塊（每處各 180 枚金幣）。無需手動標記或蓄力。

items.en: Click on the ground or in midair to slam down. Bigger drops unleash wider shockwaves and far bigger harvests, up to 82,000 coins. Bag overflow banks automatically. 3-second recovery after landing.
items.text: 在地面或空中點選即可向下重砸。下落越高，衝擊波越寬，收集量越大，最多 82,000 枚金幣。超出背包容量的金幣自動存入銀行。落地後需恢復 3 秒。

items.en: Press LMB to hook a seam, then hold to reel in gold. If the cable breaks or the seam runs dry, release and click again to recast.
items.text: 按下滑鼠左鍵鉤住礦脈，再持續按住以卷收金幣。纜繩斷裂或礦脈耗盡時，鬆開並再次點選即可重新拋鉤。

items.en: +50,000 carry. 90,000 total with earlier bags, before skill bonuses.
items.text: 背包容量 +50,000。結合先前背包後基礎容量達 90,000（技能加成前）。

items.en: 240x base deposit speed. Keeps unloading brief as hauls grow.
items.text: 基礎存幣速度為 240 倍，收集再多也能快速卸幣。

items.en: Right-click recalls your deployed vacuum grenade from anywhere, even through walls. No earlier utility purchases required.
items.text: 按滑鼠右鍵可從任意位置召回已部署的真空聚幣手雷，即使隔著牆壁也能召回。無需購買其他前置輔助道具。

items.en: Click or hold to launch fast, growing orbs. Direct hits scoop up to 900 coins; wall bounces widen the blast and raise it to 1,800.
items.text: 點選或按住可發射快速移動、不斷變大的球體。直接命中最多收集 900 枚金幣；撞牆反彈後範圍擴大，上限提高至 1,800 枚。

items.en: Click to open a rift in aimed gold up to 18m away and pull up to 720 coins into your bag. Hold to repeat every 0.65 seconds. A broad 3m scoop, with no charge or player teleport.
items.text: 瞄準 18 米內的金幣並點選，可開啟裂隙，吸取最多 720 枚金幣。按住可每 0.65 秒發動一次。收集半徑 3 米；無需蓄力，也不會傳送角色。

items.en: 3,000 coins/sec and a 5m sweep. Gather the final scattered gold.
items.text: 每秒收集 3,000 枚金幣，收集範圍為 5 米。收回最後散落的金幣。

items.en: +90,000 carry. 180,000 total with earlier bags, before skill bonuses.
items.text: 背包容量 +90,000。結合先前背包後基礎容量達 180,000（技能加成前）。

items.en: 600x base deposit speed. A fast final cash-in at any hopper.
items.text: 基礎存幣速度為 600 倍，可在任意存幣料斗快速完成最後的存幣。

items.en: A skill-tree exclusive. +40,000 carry before skill bonuses. Stacks with your other bags.
items.text: 技能樹專屬。背包容量 +40,000（技能加成前），可與其他背包疊加。

items.en: A skill-tree exclusive. 1,200x base deposit speed. Strongest coupler applies.
items.text: 技能樹專屬。基礎存幣速度為 1,200 倍。同類耦合器僅最強效果生效。

items.en: A golden plushy with no financial qualifications. Zero stat bonuses. Unlimited moral support.
items.text: 一隻沒有金融資質的金色毛絨玩偶。屬性加成：0。精神支援：無限。

items.en: Uncover the board and its landing
items.text: 清理告示板與作業平臺周圍的金幣以解鎖

items.en: Clear the coins around this board
items.text: 清理告示板周圍的金幣以進行互動

items.en: Press [R] to triple chute drainage for 8 seconds.
items.text: 按 [R] 使輸送槽排幣速率變為三倍，持續 8 秒。

items.en: Automation and the run timer continue while you use other windows.
items.text: 使用其他視窗時，自動化效果和本輪計時仍會繼續。

items.en: Gold Rush: fully empty a bag after banking at least 10% of its capacity at a station. Activates automatically.
items.text: 淘金熱：在存幣站存入至少 10% 背包容量的金幣並徹底清空背包後自動啟用。

items.en: Jackhammer: equip Shovel [2], aim at gold, then hold right mouse for 0.65s to leap and slam on landing.
items.text: 衝擊錘：裝備鏟子 [2]，瞄準金幣，按住滑鼠右鍵 0.65 秒即可躍向目標並在落地時重砸。

items.en: Magnetic Pulse: equip Magnet [3], then right mouse launches violet lightning. Base recharge: 6 seconds; upgrades shorten it.
items.text: 磁脈衝：裝備磁鐵 [3]，按滑鼠右鍵發射紫色閃電。基礎充能時間：6 秒，升級可縮短。

items.en: Power scoop: equip Shovel [2], hold right mouse to charge, then release.
items.text: 強力鏟取：裝備鏟子 [2]，按住滑鼠右鍵蓄力，再鬆開。

items.en: Two-handed technique: equip Hands [1], aim at gold, then hold right mouse and release during the sweet spot. Both grip cooldowns shorten with purchased pickup speed, up to 33%. Flow speed does not reduce them.
items.text: 雙手技法：裝備雙手 [1]，瞄準金幣，按住滑鼠右鍵並在最佳時機視窗內鬆開。兩種抓握冷卻時間均隨購買的拾取速度升級而縮短（至多縮短 33%）；心流速度加成不縮短該冷卻。

items.text: 基礎速度下，觸發機率 32%：閃電連鎖命中 5 處金幣堆，每處相當於一次常規拾取量（保底 4 枚金幣）。效果就緒後，在 6 次成功收集內保底觸發。冷卻時間：0.85 秒。適用於所有工具。

items.en: At base speed, Heavy Strike has a 22% chance to collect 3 normal pickups (minimum 12 coins). Guaranteed within 8 successful collections while ready. Cooldown: 1.2s. All tools.

items.en: Each discharge launches 8 chains instead of 6. Total lightning strength +25%, shared across the chains. Chance to keep jumping: 80% instead of 65%.

items.text: 雙手：按住滑鼠右鍵瞄準黃金，在最佳時機鬆開。每次至少收集 8 次抓取量或背包容量的 25%。冷卻時間：成功時 4.5 秒，失敗時 1.5 秒；已購買的速度升級可縮短兩種冷卻時間。

items.text: 重擊收集的金幣數提高 33%（至少 96 枚），覆蓋半徑至少為 4 米。基礎速度下，效果就緒後 4 次成功收集內必定觸發。冷卻時間：0.85 秒。

items.en: Heavy strikes collect 50% more coins (base minimum 48 before the other-tool penalty) over a 50% wider area.
items.text: 重擊收集的金幣數提高 50%（其他工具減益生效前，基礎最低收集量為 48 枚），範圍擴大 50%。

items.en: Hold right mouse 0.65s: aim, leap 25 m, slam. Harvest 20× the stronger of your scoop or Heavy Strike; falls boost impact. Cooldown: 14s. Replaces Power scoop.

items.en: Jackhammer power doubles from 20 to 40 times your scoop or learned Heavy Strike strength. Excavation depth: 1.5 m. Cooldown: 11s instead of 14s.
items.text: 衝擊錘威力翻倍，從鏟取或已習得的重擊強度的 20 倍變為 40 倍。挖掘深度：1.5 米。冷卻時間：11 秒，原為 14 秒。

items.en: Jackhammer power doubles from 40 to 80 times your scoop or learned Heavy Strike strength. Excavates 2.25 m deep.
items.text: 衝擊錘威力翻倍，從鏟取或已習得的重擊強度的 40 倍變為 80 倍。挖掘深度為 2.25 米。

items.en: Jackhammer power rises from 80 to 120 times your scoop or learned Heavy Strike strength. Excavates 3 m deep. Cooldown: 9s instead of 11s.
items.text: 衝擊錘威力從鏟取或已習得的重擊強度的 80 倍提高至 120 倍。挖掘深度為 3 米。冷卻時間：9 秒，原為 11 秒。

items.en: Keep Flow through misses and short pauses: collect within 1.5s of your tool being ready. Switching tools or opening a menu still resets Flow.
items.text: 抓空或短暫停頓時也能保持心流：工具就緒後 1.5 秒內繼續收集即可。切換工具或開啟選單仍會重設心流。

items.en: Keep using tools while unloading into a Pocket Bank. Manual station deposits still pause collection; automatic deposits let you keep working.
items.text: 向隨身銀行卸幣時可繼續使用工具。在普通存幣站手動存幣時，仍會暫停收集；自動存幣則可讓你繼續工作。

items.text: 已習得的閃電也會受益於工具金幣收集能力。

items.text: 輸送槽紅燈閃爍時按 [R] 啟用超速。輸送槽排幣速率 +200%，持續 8 秒。冷卻時間：45 秒。

items.text: 滑鼠右鍵釋放 3 條鏈，穿過 8 片區域，每次彈跳至少共享 4 次普通拾取量。閃電升級可增強此效果。冷卻時間：6 秒。

items.text: 按 [4] 裝備隨身銀行。按住滑鼠左鍵預覽，預覽變綠時鬆開放置；按 [F] 收起。自動收集 12 米內的金幣，每秒 30 枚，背包容量每增加 1,000，再增加 3 枚（基礎上限為每秒 150 枚）。
